newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK govt bills sluggish, pending U.S. rate news.
newsitem.headline: HK govt bills sluggish, pending U.S. rate news.

text.p: Hong Kong's interbank and government notes and bills markets were mostly unchanged, trapped in a sluggish lull pending a decision on interest rates in the United States, dealers said on Thursday.
The overnight interbank market stood at 5-3/16 1/4 percent versus 5-1/16 1/4 percent on Wednesday while three months stood at 5-5/8 9/16 percent versus 5-1/2 7/16 percent.
"There is nothing much going on, everyone is waiting for the U.S. decision on interest rates," a dealer with a local bank said.
The trading lull was also seen on government bills and notes where yields were unchanged from Wednesday.
The one-week bill yielded 5.00 percent while the seven-year Exchange Fund note yielded 7.60 percent, five-year 7.30 percent and three-year 6.65 percent.
